title: Honey Soy Chicken Skewers with Rice and Slaw
desc: Sticky honey soy chicken thigh skewers off the barbecue, with rice and a crunchy lime slaw.

portions.J: 3 skewers (220 g raw chicken), a cup of cooked rice, a big handful of slaw
portions.P: 2 skewers (140 g raw chicken), 2/3 cup cooked rice, a handful of slaw

ingredients.name: chicken thigh, cut into 3 cm pieces

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Mix the soy, honey, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Toss the chicken through and leave 20 minutes (or overnight). If using bamboo skewers, soak them now.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook it (absorption or rice cooker). Brown rice takes about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Thread and grill
steps.text: Thread the chicken onto skewers. Barbecue on medium-high, turning every couple of minutes, until sticky, charred at the edges and cooked through. Brush with leftover marinade only in the first half of cooking.

steps.title: Slaw and serve
steps.text: Toss the slaw mix and spring onion with the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Serve the skewers over rice with the slaw.

notes: The honey catches easily: medium-high, not blazing, and keep them moving.
short: Honey soy chicken skewers, rice, slaw
